arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Miller argued Congress directed the Veterans Court to account for prejudicial error.
Mr. Meade argued notice is integral to the system Congress designed.
Mr. Lippman argued the grave doubt standard assumes a fully developed record.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether the VA must notify veterans before denying benefits. the sides that brought the case seek a rule that missing notice harms veterans. the opposing sides seek a rule that veterans must prove specific harm.
